description: Deterministic if/then rules — set fields, transition, stop the chain. No LLM.
purpose: Runs an ordered list of if/then rules against the conversation memory — no LLM call, instant and free. Each rule has WHEN (the same AND-conditions as filters, PLUS a 'formula' condition: a single JavaScript expression over {{field}} tokens, e.g. `{{age}} > 50 || {{stage}} == 'post'` — that's how OR is expressed; empty WHEN = always fires) and THEN (one or more actions: set a field to a fixed value / another field's value / a JS formula like `yearsSince({{birthdate}})` or `{{a}} + {{b}}`; clear a field; transition to a crew; stop the rest of the chain; reply with fixed text). Formulas are single expressions — no loops or statements — evaluated with a hard timeout. Rules run top to bottom, every matching rule fires, later writes win. Use it to replace fixed decisions that used to live in prompts (age thresholds, defaults, routing) — the LLM should only handle judgment and tone. Place it AFTER extractors so it sees fresh values. Common pattern: extractor detects `intent`, a rule sets a targeted-KB field or transitions with stop-chain so an expensive thinker never runs when the data already decides.
